dialogue.text: [wry, building tension] On his way out, the bank hands him a little gift box, and inside is a heavy silver pen.
His pen doesn't have a chain.
At fifty million, the bank works for you.
[warm, slower] At five o'clock the doors are locked, and Jess looks at her own account again. She's still ninety-four dollars in the red, with a gray badge next to her name.
[warm, slower] So she calls the number one more time, and this time she keeps saying "representative" until a real person picks up. Then she asks them to waive the fee.
I can do that as a one-time courtesy.
